verdict.rationale: Sentry's own docs say it ingests OpenTelemetry traces and logs over OTLP endpoints, either directly from an OTel SDK or through the OpenTelemetry Collector. They also describe an OTLP integration that shares trace context between Sentry and OTel. Support is documented only for traces and logs, and the 'first-class' depth has no corroboration, so coverage is partial rather than complete. missing for 10: evidence of OTLP metrics ingestion, details on endpoint and protocol support (gRPC/HTTP, auth), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the OTLP ingestion path.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send telemetry directly over OTLP with first-class OpenTelemetry support

citations.quote: Sentry can ingest OpenTelemetry traces and logs via OTLP endpoints, either directly from an OTel SDK or through a pipeline tool like the OpenTelemetry Collector.
Use the [OTLP Integration](/concepts/otlp/sentry-with-otel/#otlp-integration) to share trace context between Sentry and OTel
